description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_Axis_Marker_Area' which is used for explicitly highlighting an area on a graph within a visualization library. It extends 'Image_Graph_Grid' and provides functionality for setting upper and lower bounds of the area to be marked, and rendering that marked area on the graph canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Marker_Area
classes.description: A class for highlighting an explicit area on a graph, based on axis intervals, extending the Image_Graph_Grid functionality.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Marker_Area
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the marker area, calling parent constructor.

methods.name: setLowerBound
methods.description: Sets the lower bound of the highlighted area on the axis.

methods.name: setUpperBound
methods.description: Sets the upper bound of the highlighted area on the axis.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the highlighted area on the canvas by creating a polygon between the secondary axis points and specified bounds.
